QUICKBATTLEMAP.DropInstructions: Drop a background image or video, and optionally a JSON file with walls and lights.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.DropInstructionsMore: If no JSON is provided, the module can try to auto-detect grid size from the image. You can also create a scene with no grid. Universal VTT maps (.dd2vtt, .df2vtt, .uvtt) belong on the Universal VTT tab.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.MissingFiles: A background image or video is required
QUICKBATTLEMAP.InvalidJSON: The JSON file could not be parsed
QUICKBATTLEMAP.NoGridHint: Skips applying or detecting a grid. Useful for maps without visible grid lines.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ProgressNote: Shows ongoing tasks like uploading and auto-detecting grid size.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can import battlemaps.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.UvttInstructions: Import Dungeondraft, DungeonFog, Arkenforge, or AutoWall maps exported as Universal VTT.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.StorageHint: Select where the image is uploaded.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.WebpHint: Save images as WebP. They are smaller, and conversion takes longer.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.CustomPpiHint: Override the map's pixels-per-grid value and change the resolution of the generated image.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.PathHint: Path relative to your User Data folder, for example worlds/yourworld/maps.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.PathWarning: Your path should be relative to your User Data folder, for example worlds/yourworld/maps, or blank to place the image in the Data folder.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.FidelityHint: How many cave-wall points to keep. Left is fewer walls and better performance. Right keeps every point.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.FidelityWarning: Higher fidelity creates a very large number of cave walls. The minimum is recommended.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ObjectWallsHint: Include walls from objects that block line of sight.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.PaddingHint: Canvas padding around the map, as a fraction of the scene size.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ImageFileName: Image file name (also the scene name when Scene Name is empty)
QUICKBATTLEMAP.LevelsSameSize: Levels mode stacks each file on its own elevation. Images should be the same size.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.WebpQualityHint: Higher quality uses more disk space and takes longer to encode.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.OffsetHint: Nudges cave walls away from the painted edge. Leave at 0 if the walls already line up.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.BucketRequired: An S3 bucket is required when Storage Type is S3.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.ReadFailed: Could not read the selected files
QUICKBATTLEMAP.SkipFile: Skipped a file that could not be read
QUICKBATTLEMAP.AttachFailed: The dropped file could not be attached. Choose it with the file button instead.
QUICKBATTLEMAP.OpenableWindowsHint: Import every portal as a door. When this is off, portals that do not block light are imported as windows. In Dungeondraft, uncheck Block Light on a portal to mark it as a window.
